pr_title: Guard against unbounded grow of suppressed exceptions storage
pr_body:
Motivation:

We should guard against unbounded grows of suppressed exceptions in our SSLEngine implementation to prevent possible OOME

Modifications:

- Check if a suppressed exception was already added for a specific error code before adding it again
- Ensure we always null out pending exception field.

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/13350

issue_context.title: OOM in ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine due to suppressed exceptions accumulating in pendingException
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/netty/netty/discussions/13349
Originally posted by **tkowalcz** April 20, 2023 `ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine` has a `pendingException` field, it's purpose seems to be to store exceptions, do some cleanup and rethrow them later at a more convenient time. There is also code that appends subsequent exceptions to `pendingException` as `suppressed`: ```java ThrowableUtil.addSuppressed(pendingException, exception); ``` In my particular case this led to OOM error where `ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine` occupied almost 8gb of heap with 12 million of suppressed exceptions. Screenshot from Eclipse MAT: Netty version where this occurred is `4.1.53.Final`. It does not look like handling these exceptions is different compared to master. We also used `netty-tcnative-boringssl-static` in version `2.0.46.Final`. What might be interesting is that the underlying SSL error is `TOO_MANY_KEY_UPDATES`. I found [this report similar](https://lists.apache.org/list.html?user@cassandra.apache.org) but without OOM. Here is the BoringSSL code reporting this error: https://github.com/google/boringssl/blob/bcecc7d834fc44ad257b2f23f88e1cf597ab2736/ssl/tls13_both.cc#L677. I have trouble reproducing `TOO_MANY_KEY_UPDATES` error. I will appreciate any pointers on how to trigger that, then I'll try to make a reproducer based on master branch.
